lines: Smartphones are the must-have devices for people these days.
“I often bring my smartphone to the bathroom,” said a 14-year-old student.
“I also use it just before I go to bed and right after I wake up.
I just can’t live without my smartphone.”
Regarding this situation, the government encourages students to understand their levels of smartphone addiction through a self-test.
Doctors warn about the danger of smartphone addiction in teens.
It has negative effects on the brains of students.
When they are addicted to smartphones, students find it difficult to make a decision or control their feelings.
Besides, as they constantly check their phones while they are studying, they can’t focus on their studies.
